meta.tool: Playwright Chromium 1194 (headless), proxy via local agent proxy

method.bytes: sum over finished requests of responseBodySize+responseHeadersSize (Playwright request.sizes()); encoded/transfer sizes, so compressed text counts small.
method.initial_load_plus_6s: after load event + 6 s idle, before any interaction
method.after_scroll_total: home/PLP pages: after cookie dismissal and auto-scroll to the bottom (capped at 14000 px) to trigger lazy-loading; PDP pages: after one scroll to ~2200 px for the sticky-ATC test
method.thirdPartyScriptDomains: distinct registrable domains (eTLD+1 approximation) of script resources whose domain differs from the page host; Shopify CDN domains (shopify.com, shop.app) count as third-party
method.lcpMs: last largest-contentful-paint entry via buffered PerformanceObserver, read ~6 s after load; single cold run from a cloud container, so treat as indicative, not field data
method.caveat_video: This Chromium build does not play H.264/MP4, so autoplay video heroes render as blank/grey/poster frames in screenshots (motelrocks, ottolinger, acnestudios desktop poster). Video presence is detected from DOM <video> elements.
method.caveat_heuristics: PLP grid columns, gallery type, sticky ATC and text signals are DOM heuristics; BENCHMARK.md corrects them where screenshots show otherwise (e.g. Represent PLP reported 10 columns because of a collection carousel; visually 4 desktop / 2 mobile).
